findings.finding: No cross-query imagined observation history found
findings.basis: GC_Agent.act re-encodes actual observation; EncPredWM.unroll accumulates predictions only in local per-query rollout state.
findings.decision: No actionable new contamination path established.

findings.finding: CEM previous mean is stored but not consumed as warm start
findings.basis: Native CEM rebuilds mean/std for each plan. Persistent local RNG advances with calls.
findings.decision: Extra-call RNG effects alone are ordinary stateful sampling; no native multitenant service or distinct security boundary demonstrated.

findings.finding: Final horizon includes one more physical control than executed
findings.basis: Remaining9 controls -> two5-control macro actions; native cost evaluates predicted endpoint after10 while TimeLimit ends after9.
findings.decision: Ordinary planning/execution granularity mismatch; an exact simulator can have the same issue. No attacker-writable independent tail interface found, and no attribution to seed2 failure.

findings.finding: Raw commands can exceed actuator saturation limits
findings.basis: See observed counts and native set_xyz_action clipping.
findings.decision: The predictor may legitimately learn the saturated-command mapping. This does not prove forecast error; no revival of retired action-alias claim.

findings.finding: Logged CEM minimum is distinct from the executed elite-mean action cost
findings.basis: Native planner stores candidate minimum losses and returns elite-mean actions.
findings.decision: Do not treat minimum_cost_per_iteration as the predicted cost of the actually executed plan.

decision: Do not initiate attacks or tune the frozen Clean panel from these observations. Continue with a matched ordinary-controller baseline to test resource suitability.
